{{Quote|Hers was the tale of the Empire's hired gun who comes to dine with blood soaked hands and frosted smile like honey wine, transfixing like the serpent before it strikes with equal compassion&hellip;|An excerpt from Thalos Lorin's play ''Serpent's Rain''|<ref name="Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>}}
'''Thalos Lorin''' was a playwright, who was made well known by the drama ''[[Serpent Rain]]''.

==Behind the scenes==
Lorin was mentioned in the online game [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], in a question that the [[Unidentified Theed Palace librarian|Theed Palace librarian]] can ask player characters.
